SELECT id,company_name,company_address, contact_name,contact_mobile, contact_address,currency,disabled, create_time,is_deleted,kingdee_id FROM sys_accounting_company sac WHERE is_deleted=false
AND sac.disabled =false
AND sac.disabled =true
AND sac.${params.searchType} ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%')
ORDER BY update_time DESC
